mentions.name: asm.build
mentions.description: A package manager for assembly projects, built on the thesis that as AI makes writing code cheap, software can be written directly for each architecture in assembly rather than higher-level languages like Rust, since running costs will matter more.
mentions.problem: High-level programming languages exist as abstractions for humans; as writing code becomes cheaper, code can be written for each architecture directly, and the costs of running code matter more in relation.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://asm.build - the package manager for assembly projects.
mentions.author: stubbi
